Class AlgoMessageAlert

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.TenantBaseID
grafioschtrader.entities.AlgoMessageAlert
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@Entity public class AlgoMessageAlert extends TenantBaseID implements Serializable
JPA entity for the algo_message_alert table. Stores alarm records generated by the alarm evaluation system when alert conditions on strategies or watchlist securities are triggered. Each record captures the signal kind, structured JSON details about the condition that fired, and the time of triggering. Used by both Tier 1 (event-driven simple alerts) and Tier 2 (scheduled indicator alerts).

The columns idTenant, idAlgoStrategy, idSecurityCurrency, alarmType, signalDirection, trancheKey and alertDay together form the signal identity and carry the unique key UK_AlarmDay. That key is the daily deduplication: an insert that violates it means the same signal was already reported today. All seven are therefore non-null, with 0 standing for "no instrument" and "no direction" and the empty string for "no tranche" - a nullable column would be distinct from itself in a MariaDB unique index and would let the same alarm be written without limit.
